pages.text: $(bold)Spoils vs. Currency$()$(br2)Two reward types, easy to confuse:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Progression tokens$() advance your tier (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)).$(li)$(bold)Spoils$() — relics, boss materials, Simply Swords uniques, gems — are loot. They make you stronger, but they do $(bold)not$() advance tiers and cannot be spent as tokens.$(br2)Hunt bosses for spoils because the gear is the best in the pack — not because you need them to progress.

pages.title: Relics
pages.text: Relics are exploration and combat trophies — found in structures and dropped by bosses. They level up as you use them and stack into serious endgame power.$(br2)A relic is pure $(italic)spoils$(): it never counts toward a tier threshold. Keep the ones that fit your build; they are a reward layer that runs alongside progression, not part of it.

pages.title: Play Hybrid
pages.text: Because all four lanes feed one pool, you never have to commit to a single path. Build a few Create machines, loot a dimension, kill a boss or two — every bit banks into the same total.$(br2)The $(bold)pure paths$() exist so a specialist is never blocked from advancing. The $(bold)combined pool$() exists so everyone else can simply play, in any mix, and progress.$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft codex balance and see where your mix already stands.$()
